title: The Vetra Studio BUILD preview is a dev render where processors never run and preview drives are ephemeral
content:
## What the preview actually is

The BUILD pane deep-links into the **reactor project** the agent spawned for the session — a dev-mode process, one per active build. The sequence: the agent calls `reactor-project-init` then `reactor-project-start` (both visible as tool cards), the dev server warms up in roughly 10–30 seconds, and the agent calls `spec-preview-show` with a project, drive and app reference to surface the app. From then on Vite HMR picks up generated code without a full reload.

A running reactor project is **not sufficient on its own** — until the agent explicitly surfaces a preview the pane reads *"No preview yet — The BUILD preview appears once the agent scaffolds a project for this session."*

## Two things the preview cannot show you

**Processors do not run.** They execute server-side in Switchboard, only once the studio is deployed. So any behaviour mediated by a processor — the doc's example is syncing a guest order to a staff board — looks broken in preview and starts working after deploy, with no code change in between. If you are debugging a missing read model or an unfired side effect in preview, the absence *is* the expected behaviour, not a bug to chase.

**Preview drives are ephemeral and reset between sessions.** Documents you create to exercise the UI are not durable, so preview is not a place to build up test fixtures. This mirrors the local convention where the `vetra` drive holds source documents (models, editors, apps) and the preview drive holds instances — with the cloud preview drive additionally being disposable.

Both limits follow from the same fact: preview is a *dev render of the editors and apps*, not a runtime. Editors and drive apps are exactly the parts that live in the browser, so those are the parts you can see. Anything whose execution belongs to a host — processors, subgraph resolvers, sync channels — needs the real Switchboard.

Because the product is pre-alpha, the preview also does not always mount at all; if it stays on "No preview yet", deploy the app to see it end to end.

_Source: `apps/academy/docs/academy/01-GetStarted/00-VetraStudio.md` (The BUILD preview), Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: Preview runs editors and apps in a local dev reactor; processor-mediated behaviour only works after deploying to Switchboard, and drives reset between sessions.
